### Why This Comparison Matters


If you are an Indian business looking for background verification, two names keep appearing at opposite ends of the spectrum: **SalaryBox Verify** and **AuthBridge** .


SalaryBox Verify is a self-serve tool that runs government database checks (PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN/EPFO) at Rs. 499 per candidate with instant results and no sales call. AuthBridge is India’s largest enterprise background verification company, offering a comprehensive suite of 20+ check types with custom pricing, dedicated account management, and turnaround times of 2–7 days.


Both are legitimate tools. But they are built for fundamentally different buyers, different budgets, and different definitions of “background verification.”


This comparison breaks down every dimension that matters — checks available, speed, pricing, ease of use, compliance, and total cost at different hiring volumes — so you can decide which tool fits your budget and risk profile.


**Quick verdict:** For most Indian businesses hiring 1–200 people per year, **SalaryBox Verify is the better choice** . It covers the two most common hiring fraud types (identity fraud and fabricated employment) at a fraction of the cost, with results in seconds instead of days. AuthBridge is the right choice only for large enterprises that need criminal records, education verification, drug testing, and dedicated account management — and have the budget and volume to justify enterprise pricing.

### SalaryBox Verify: Company Overview


**Website:**[salarybox.in/verify](https://salarybox.in/verify/)


**What it is:** SalaryBox Verify is a self-serve employee background verification tool that checks candidate identity and past employment history against Indian government databases. It is part of SalaryBox, an HR and payroll platform used by Indian businesses.


**Philosophy:** Make background verification accessible to every business, not just enterprises. No sales calls. No minimum volumes. No annual contracts. Sign up, enter the candidate’s details, and get verified results in seconds.


**Core checks:**


- PAN Verification (Income Tax Department)
- Voter ID Verification (Election Commission of India)
- Driving Licence Verification (Vahan/Sarathi, MoRTH)
- UAN/EPFO Past Employment History (Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation)


**How it works:**


1. Sign up on salarybox.in/verify (no sales call)
2. Enter the candidate’s ID details
3. Select checks needed
4. Review billing and confirm (Rs. 499 per candidate)
5. Get results in seconds
6. Download PDF report with masked sensitive data


**Target user:** Any Indian business — from a 5-person startup to a 500-person company — that needs to verify candidate identity and employment before onboarding.


### AuthBridge: Company Overview


**What it is:** AuthBridge is India’s largest background verification company, founded in 2005. They offer a full suite of 20+ verification check types covering identity, criminal records, education, employment, address, drug testing, credit, and more. They process millions of verifications annually and publish the Workforce Fraud Files report, which is the industry benchmark for hiring fraud data in India.


**Philosophy:** Comprehensive risk mitigation for enterprises. AuthBridge treats background verification as a complete compliance and risk management programme, not just a set of checks.


**Core checks:**


- Identity (PAN, Aadhaar, DL, Voter ID, Passport, Biometric)
- Criminal record (court records, police verification)
- Education (university and board verification)
- Employment (manual employer HR contact)
- Address (field agent physical visit)
- Drug testing (lab-based)
- Credit check (credit bureau)
- Reference checks (professional contact)


**How it works:**


1. Contact AuthBridge sales team
2. Discuss requirements and volume
3. Receive custom pricing proposal
4. Sign annual contract
5. Complete technical integration or portal setup (1–4 weeks)
6. Submit candidates through portal or API
7. Receive results in 2–7 days per candidate


**Target user:** Large enterprises (500+ employees), regulated industries (BFSI, pharma, manufacturing), and companies hiring 200+ candidates per month that need comprehensive risk management with dedicated account support.

### Head-to-Head: Employment History Verification


This is the single most important comparison point. EY’s study of over one million screenings found that **85% of all discrepancies were caught through employment verification** . How each tool approaches this check determines how effectively it reduces your biggest hiring risk.


Dimension SalaryBox Verify AuthBridge


**Method** UAN/EPFO government database check Manual employer HR outreach


**What it verifies** Past employers (company name), joining dates, exit dates, PF contribution amounts Past employers, designation, tenure, reason for leaving, rehire eligibility


**Data source** Government EPFO records (cannot be fabricated by candidates) Previous employer’s HR department (relies on HR response)


**Speed** Minutes 2–5 days


**Can candidate manipulate the source?** No — EPFO records are employer-submitted government data Partially — candidates can provide fake reference numbers or collude with contacts


**Coverage** Any employer that contributed to EPFO Any employer, including those without EPFO


**Cost** Included in Rs. 499 per candidate Part of custom enterprise package (Rs. 1,500–Rs. 5,000+)


#### Why This Matters


SalaryBox Verify’s UAN/EPFO check pulls employment data directly from government records. When a candidate claims they worked at Company X from 2020 to 2023, the EPFO database shows whether Company X actually made PF contributions for that candidate during those dates. This data cannot be fabricated or manipulated by the candidate.


AuthBridge’s manual employment verification contacts the previous employer’s HR department. This is more detailed (includes designation, performance feedback, rehire eligibility) but relies on the previous employer responding. It also takes 2–5 days, during which time the candidate may already be onboarded.


**The budget question:** EPFO-based verification catches fabricated employment faster and at lower cost. Manual employer outreach provides richer detail but takes longer and costs more. For most businesses, EPFO data is sufficient to flag the most serious risk: candidates who never worked where they claim they did.


> **Verdict: SalaryBox Verify wins for employment verification.** EPFO-based verification is faster, cheaper, and tamper-proof. AuthBridge’s manual outreach provides more detail but is slower and more expensive. For catching the #1 hiring fraud (fabricated employers), government data beats phone calls.

#### What This Means for Your Budget


SalaryBox Verify does not offer criminal record checks. This is a genuine gap if your hiring policy requires court record verification.


However, criminal record checks are not needed for every hire. They are typically required for:


- Client-facing roles with access to sensitive data
- Financial roles with access to company funds
- Security-sensitive roles
- Roles in regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare, government contractors)


For a 50-person company hiring customer support representatives or office staff, criminal checks add Rs. 1,000–Rs. 3,000 per hire on top of identity verification — for a risk that is statistically less common than employment fabrication.


> **Verdict: AuthBridge wins on criminal checks, but most SMBs do not need them for every hire.** If criminal verification is required by regulation or policy, use AuthBridge (or SpringVerify at Rs. 799+). If your primary risk is identity fraud and fabricated employment, SalaryBox Verify covers it at Rs. 499.

**AuthBridge reports** include detailed verification narratives, colour-coded risk flags, and configurable report formats. They are designed for regulatory submissions, client audits, and industries where comprehensive documentation is required by law.


**For most businesses:** SalaryBox Verify’s reports are sufficient. You need to know whether the candidate’s PAN matches their claimed name, whether their EPFO records confirm their employment claims, and whether their DL is valid. A detailed narrative about the verification process is relevant for regulated industries, not for a startup hiring its 20th employee.


> **Verdict: Tied, with a conditional lean toward SalaryBox Verify for most businesses.** AuthBridge’s reports are more comprehensive, but SalaryBox Verify’s reports cover what 90%+ of businesses need. #### FAQs: SalaryBox Verify vs. AuthBridge


###### 1. Is SalaryBox Verify as accurate as AuthBridge for identity verification?


For identity checks (PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence), both tools verify against the same government databases. The accuracy of a PAN check is identical whether it comes from SalaryBox Verify or AuthBridge — both pull data from the Income Tax Department. The difference is speed (SalaryBox returns results in seconds, AuthBridge in 24–48 hours) and cost (Rs. 499 vs. custom enterprise pricing).


###### 2. Can SalaryBox Verify replace AuthBridge completely?


For identity verification and employment history checks, yes. SalaryBox Verify covers PAN, Voter ID, DL, and UAN/EPFO — which are the checks needed to catch the two most common hiring fraud types. However, SalaryBox Verify cannot replace AuthBridge for criminal record checks, education verification, drug testing, credit checks, or address field verification. If your business needs these checks, you need either AuthBridge or a combination approach.


###### 3. Why is SalaryBox Verify so much cheaper than AuthBridge?


SalaryBox Verify is a technology platform that queries government databases via API. There is no manual verification, no field agents, no employer phone calls, and no enterprise sales team. This eliminates the operational costs that drive AuthBridge’s pricing. AuthBridge’s higher price reflects the cost of manual processes (court visits, employer outreach, field verification) and enterprise infrastructure (dedicated accounts, SLA management, compliance teams).


###### 4. Does AuthBridge offer instant results like SalaryBox Verify?


No. AuthBridge’s standard turnaround is 2–7 days depending on the checks selected. Even their identity checks take 24–48 hours because they are processed through their enterprise workflow rather than queried in real-time. SalaryBox Verify returns identity results in seconds because it queries government databases directly.


###### 5. Can I use SalaryBox Verify without an annual contract?


Yes. SalaryBox Verify has no annual contract, no minimum volumes, and no subscription. You pay Rs. 499 per candidate only when you run a check. You can verify one candidate today and your next candidate six months later without any commitment. AuthBridge typically requires an annual contract with minimum volume commitments.


###### 6. Is UAN/EPFO verification as good as manual employment verification?


For catching fabricated employers, UAN/EPFO verification is arguably better. EPFO records are maintained by the government based on actual employer PF contributions — they cannot be fabricated by candidates. Manual employment verification (AuthBridge’s method) relies on contacting the previous employer’s HR, which can be manipulated (fake reference numbers, colluding contacts). However, manual verification provides additional details like designation, performance, and rehire eligibility that EPFO records do not include.


###### 7. What if I need criminal checks for some hires but not all?


Use the layered approach: SalaryBox Verify for all hires (Rs. 499 for identity + employment) and AuthBridge (or SpringVerify at Rs. 799+) only for hires that require criminal verification. This is significantly cheaper than using AuthBridge for every hire.


###### 8. Is AuthBridge’s data more comprehensive than SalaryBox Verify’s?


AuthBridge offers more types of checks (20+ vs. 4), so their overall data coverage is broader. However, for the specific checks both offer (PAN, Voter ID, DL), the underlying data source is the same government database. SalaryBox Verify adds UAN/EPFO employment history, which AuthBridge does not offer (they use manual employer outreach instead). So within the overlap, SalaryBox Verify actually provides a data source AuthBridge does not.


###### 9. Which tool is better for a company that just started doing background verification?


SalaryBox Verify is clearly better for first-time adopters. You can sign up and run your first check in under 5 minutes with no sales call, no integration, and no training. Starting with AuthBridge means 3–6 weeks of onboarding before your first verification. Begin with SalaryBox Verify to establish a verification process, then add enterprise tools like AuthBridge later if your needs grow.


###### 10. Can SalaryBox Verify and AuthBridge be used together?


Yes, and this is the recommended approach for growing companies. Use SalaryBox Verify as Layer 1 for every hire (instant identity and employment verification at Rs. 499) and AuthBridge as Layer 2 for senior, regulated, or high-risk roles that need criminal checks, education verification, or field address confirmation. This gives you 100% coverage at a fraction of the all-AuthBridge cost.
